We are releasing a hotfix to remedy some issues occurring in the game on PC&Mac.

You can confirm the version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.

Changelist

Ch3 v.0.0.088
Fixed a softlock where you can get teleported to the Green Room during the battle with one of the
final bosses, and be permanently unable to progress if you save. (This fix prevents the issue from
happening again, but unfortunately if you had this bug occur, your save file will still be broken.)
Fixed a softlock where the raft could get stuck in a wall.
Fixed a crash if you lose to the first miniboss with zero points.
Fixed a depth issue with a black tile.
Some players' computers are not compatible with the method of video display in Chapter 3. if you
reach a cinematic which crashes or freezes your game, returning to that scene once more will
give you the option to skip it.
Fixed a bug when receiving a prize for attaining the highest rank.
After defeating a certain a boss, if your inventory is too full to receive the armor in the chest, a
treasure chest will be placed into the Green Room.
Ch4 v.0.0.087
Fixed an issue where the game would crash when loading a file from Chapter 3.
Fixed a crash with a scene that could happen at the end of an area.
Fixed an issue of trapped in the closet.
We are aware of many other remaining issues, so we will be issuing one last hotfix patch
soon! After the next hotfix is on PC, we will generate a patch for consoles.

Chapter 3 v.0.0.091 v.0.0.088 v.0.0.090
Chapter 4 v.0.0.090 v.0.0.088 v.0.0.088
Changelist
Chapter 2
+ Fixed an issue in the room with fireworks where the floor switch can be pressed by an invisible character.
Chapter 3
+ Key Items received from the Ball Machine no longer incorrectly persist outside of that room. This caused
numerous issues, including not being able to receive the Shadow Crystal from a certain boss.
- Fixed an issue where Susie and Ralsei would appear completely shadowed if defeated by a boss's attack.
+ In a room where Susie destroys houses, she no longer stops moving erroneously after the battle.
However, she now slides around erroneously. Apparently this is better.
+ Attempted to fix issues on Board 1 where you can see duplicate Ralseis as well as make Ralsei disappear
indefinitely.
+ [Console-only] Fixed some situations were borders were not displaying correctly.
Chapter 4
- Fixed some places where the characters were the normal color in an area that has abnormal coloration.
- Fixed an issue where it's possible to get temporarily stuck in a playable piano.
+ Fixed an issue during an optional battle where damage numbers done to the players were not visible.
Additionally, the heal numbers were moving further to the right every time they appeared.
+ Removed the erroneous appearance of a duplicate Kris in the closet.
+ [PC-only] Fixed various display issues with the microphone select menu. Additionally, fixed a potential
softlock if you have no microphones attached.
+ [Switch 2-only] Fixed an exploit where you can generate infinite untouchable cats if you touch them
with the backside of the shield
+ [Switch 2-only] Fixed a misalignment of the petting effect and the mouse position.
+ [Switch 2-only] Fixed a crash if you saved your game in the "Mike Zone" on Nintendo Switch,
then imported your save file to Nintendo Switch 2 and continued from there.
All Chapters
+ "Master Volume" setting now persists between Chapters when using the same file.
+ [PC-only] Fixed the way the controllers are handled to alleviate some issues with TV-docked Steam Decks.
+ [Mac-only] Fixed an issue on certain Mac systems where the full-screen mode would resize improperly
when returning to the main menu from Chapter 4.
+ [PS4/PS5-only] Fixed some small hiccups which caused the gameplay to pause for a moment when a
scene was loading.
+ [Switch/Switch 2-only] Updated the save data import messages when first launching the game.
Now, if you have more than one app's save data on your console (for example, if you have saves from
both the older version of the Chapter 1&2 demo as well as the newer version), it will display them as a
list so you can choose the one you want to import. (Note: The import messages only appear if you have
no existing save data for the full version of the game...)
+ [Switch 2-only] Fixed an issue where the game displays at the wrong size on 1440p.
+ Additionally, there are several other minor aesthetic fixes across chapters 2, 3, and 4.
Testing of the next patch is already underway. The next two patches contain some
extremely slight adjustments to gameplay in addition to bug fixes.

1.05.text: DELTARUNE Patch 1.05 is now optionally available on a Steam beta branch. Access it using the beta branch "deltarune105". https://t.co/4BW7TN2hcM
1.05.ocr:
DELTARUNE STEAM BETA BRANCH - PATCH 1.05
This time, adjustments to gameplay are rather insignificant, but we made two global changes
(how cutscenes are loaded and the version of GameMaker used), so we decided to upload
1.05 to a beta branch on Steam before giving it a full release.
The beta branch is called "deltarune105" on Steam.
If anybody was just going to play the game for fun, it would be appreciated if you could play
this version. Ideally there are no notable changes, but for safety's sake, we just want to
make sure that no new issues have come up.
(If you DO find an issue, it would be great if you could report it to deltarune@fangamer.com!)
Version Numbers
PC/Mac
Chapter 1 1.41
Chapter 2 1.47
Chapter 3 v.0.0.099
Chapter 4 v.0.0.100
Changelist
Multiple Chapters
- We had to upgrade our version of GameMaker to fix a PlayStation-specific bug. The game will now
run at 30 FPS (as intended) instead of 31-32 FPS on PS4 and PSS. Ideally there should be no other
changes as a consequence of this upgrade, but we just want to make sure.
+ Cutscenes are now loaded more efficiently. This will reduce hiccups on PlayStation, as well as
on weaker PCs. (For most players, there should be NO CHANGE.)
+ Fixed a combination of inputs that would crash the game in several shops.
+ A couple other minor fixes.
Chapter 4
+ When facing bosses that swing down with a hammer, the hitbox of the attack now better matches
the area shown by the preceding flash.
- Fixed a bug which would generate empty items in your Dark World inventory if you used the
Bandage in the Light World.
We are not working on any other patches at this time. Instead, we want to concentrate all of
our resources on completing Chapter 5.
We would like to give a progress update on the status of Chapter 5 next month (September 2025)
via a newsletter.

FF DELTARUNE Chapter 5 v0.0.250 Patch
Today we released an update for PC/Mac and PlayStation to fix a few issues with the game.
Switch/Switch 2 versions will follow in the coming days/weeks once they pass certification.
You can confirm the chapter version number on the bottom right of the file select screen.
Changelist

Chapter 5 Version 0.0.250

GAMEPLAY ADDITIONS

+ A Golden Tenna Statue will now appear in Castle Town in Chapter 5 if you got it from the
Ball Machine in Chapter 3.

+ The ability to permanently re-enable Voice Clips has been shoddily added if you lose to the
Chapter Boss and have them disabled.

GAMEPLAY ISSUES

+ In Chapter 4, defeating a Titan Spawn with violence no longer erroneously counts as "Lost".
We also fixed an issue in Chapter 5 where Jackenstein would not appear in your town because of this.

+ Susie now has additional magic points in Chapter 5 if you defeated the Shadow Crystal boss of Chapter 4.

+ Fixed some issues where the number on the TP display was occasionally inaccurate.

+ You can no longer incorrectly leave a certain scene by frame-perfectly opening the menu in the
Light World.

- Fixed an issue on Nintendo consoles where a wired controller would always take priority over a
wireless controller. Now, the controller in slot 1 will always have priority.

- Fixed an issue where on gamepads, ZL / L2 would count only as a single frame press of confirm in
Chapter 5 only.

+ Fixed an issue involving bugged blank item slots which had been carried over from Chapter 4 save
files before it was fixed in that chapter.

- Fixed an issue where you can clip through the floor after fighting three scarecrows by immediately
opening the ACT menu, and other bugs involving the ACT menu.

+ You can no longer crash the game by hitting an enemy and a Mysterious Statue at the same time.
(Unless you can)

+ You can no longer walk around during combat by interacting with Final Starwalker on the same
frame you engage a battle. (And other similar issues)

- Fixed various scenarios where you can move around with the menu open.

+ Fixed certain bullet patterns not giving TP when grazed.

+ Kris will no longer stay sideways if you enter into the final cutscene of Chapter 5 sideways.

+ Fixed MANY other minor issues, visual or otherwise.

NEXT TIME

In the next patch, we will add an option to nerf the bombs of the Shadow Crystal boss after losing to

them once. Additionally, we plan to fix a small number of bugs in previous chapters which had gone

unaddressed up until this point.

There is no plan for another extensive Chapter 5 patch after the next one.

Instead, we will resume fully concentrating our development resources on Chapter 6 and 7.
